entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: UE state where E-UTRAN coverage has been lost or PSM is active. In this state, the UE shall not initiate any EMM procedure except for cell and PLMN reselection.

entities.name: E-UTRAN coverage lost
entities.description: Condition where the UE loses E-UTRAN coverage.

entities.name: PSM active
entities.description: Condition where Power Saving Mode is active in the UE.

entities.name: PSM deactivation capability
entities.description: UE can deactivate PSM by activating the AS layer when mobile originated signalling or user data needs to be sent.

entities.name: No EMM procedure initiation
entities.description: UE shall not initiate any EMM procedure except for cell and PLMN reselection while in EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.

entities.name: Cell and PLMN reselection
entities.description: Procedure that the UE is allowed to perform while in EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.

relations.description: State EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE is entered when E-UTRAN coverage is lost.
State EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE is entered when PSM is active.
When PSM is active, the UE can deactivate it by activating the AS layer for mobile originated signalling or user data.
While in EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state, the UE shall not initiate any EMM procedure except for cell and PLMN reselection.
Cell and PLMN reselection is the only EMM-related procedure allowed in EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state.
